title: Brendan O'Connor – Alpha Opportunities in Australia at Regal Partners (EP.485)

reader_summary.headline: Brendan O'Connor is the CEO of Regal Partners.
reader_summary.overview: Brendan O'Connor is the CEO of Regal Partners, a premier alternatives manager in Australia with A$21B of funds under management across hedge funds. Brendan joined the firm in 2016 and has helped lead its expansion from a $1B long short specialist to a publicly listed, multi-strategy alternatives firm today. Our conversation traces Regal's evolution from its origins as a founder-led hedge fund into an integrated multi-strategy platform.

key_points.text: Brendan O'Connor is the CEO of Regal Partners, a premier alternatives manager in Australia with A$21B of funds under management across hedge funds.
We discuss the unique economic and structural dynamics of the Australian market.
We cover Regal's 4 step investment analysis and risk process, the integration of investment teams, and perspectives on the exciting future of Australian markets.
